veranderings.voor: naby die ewenaar waar die land
veranderings.na: naby die ewenaar, waar die land
veranderings.rede: The 'waar' clause adds information about the equator rather than singling out part of it, so it takes a comma.
AWS writes an ordinal joined to a superlative as one word: 'tweedehoogste'.

veranderings.voor: Groot lopende water wat in 'n vaste baan oor die land vloei.
veranderings.na: 'n Groot stroom water wat in 'n vaste baan oor die land vloei.
veranderings.rede: 'Groot lopende water' with no article or countable noun reads as a fragment; 'n Groot stroom water' is the natural form of the same definition.

vlae.teks: 'n Meer is 'n groot hoeveelheid water wat deur land omring word.
vlae.rede: This study sentence defines 'meer' with only the first half of the decided shared wording (it leaves out 'en meestal vanself gevorm het'); not a language fault, so not changed, but a person may want to check it against the shared-definition rule.
